capital.title: Record SpaceX IPO delivers billions for Gulf investors
capital.description: Gulf investors booked billions of dollars in paper gains after Elon Musk’s SpaceX completed the largest initial public offering in history at a valuation of about $2.1 trillion. risk.title: Turkey to boost subsidies for embattled farmers
risk.description: Turkish farmers are to receive higher subsidies this year to offset sharp cost increases, notably for fuel and fertilisers, caused by the Iran war.
